content: कैशिक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) [केश-ठक्] Hairlike, fine as hair. .{@-कः@} The sentiment of love, lust. .{@-कम्@} A quantity of hair; कपटकैशिकभूषितमल्लिका <ls>Rām. Ch. 4. 37</ls>. .{@-की@} .²1 One of the four varieties of dramatic style; <ls>Rām. 5. 1. 163</ls>; more usually and correctly written कैशिकी <ab>q. v.</ab> .²2 An epithet of Durgā.
